short: The first president since Grover Cleveland to win the office back after losing it.
full:
Trump lost in 2020 and won in 2024, defeating Kamala Harris and taking the popular vote as well as the electoral college. He is the second president to serve non-consecutive terms, after Grover Cleveland in 1885 and 1893, and is counted as both the forty-fifth and the forty-seventh president. He was also the first convicted felon to hold the office, having been sentenced without penalty days before the inauguration.

The ceremony on 20 January 2025 was moved inside the Capitol rotunda because of freezing weather. He returned with a programme prepared in advance: a broad assertion of executive control over the federal bureaucracy, mass deportations, tariffs imposed under emergency economic powers, and withdrawal once more from the Paris climate accord and the World Health Organization. The Twenty-second Amendment bars a third term, so the presidency is due to end on 20 January 2029.
